Diffusers goes protein designing 🚀

It's been a while since the RFD4-Proteina model from NVIDIA was integrated into the library. It can jointly generate protein sequences and all-atom structures while conditioning on molecular context such as binding targets, motifs, or ligands.

Last week, we merged a LoRA fine-tuning script for it for experimenting on new protein folds.

Never thought I would see Diffusers being used for such a broad cause, sky is the limit I guess 🤗 

Thanks to Kieran Didi for leading these contributions!

Link to the training script in the comments 👇
